name: web-browser-mcp
description: Python MCP server driving the Obscura stealth browser over CDP — port of tools/web-browser. Interactive browser_* tools (navigate, snapshot with numbered element refs, look/screenshot, click by ref or shadow-piercing text, type, press, scroll, back, eval, wait) share one persistent page so an MCP-capable agent drives it directly. browser_browse runs the autonomous LM Studio agent loop (same JSON action protocol as agent.js) and returns {answer, steps, url, sources, model}.
use_when: driving the stealth browser from an MCP client, interactively or autonomously

args.name: --selfcheck
args.description: List registered MCP tools and exit (no browser needed).

env.LLM_BASE_URL: OpenAI-compatible endpoint for browser_browse. Default: http://127.0.0.1:1234/v1
env.AGENT_MODEL: Model for the browse agent loop. Default: qwen/qwen3-vl-8b
env.AGENT_VISION_MODEL: Vision model override; defaults to AGENT_MODEL
env.OBSCURA_BIN: Path to obscura binary. Default: vendor/obscura/obscura

notes: Client config: {"command": "uv", "args": ["run", "<repo>/tools/web-browser-mcp/server.py"]}. browser_look returns ImageContent for vision clients. Interactive tools keep one persistent page across calls; browser_browse uses a fresh context per call. Auto-starts 'obscura serve' when the CDP endpoint is unreachable.
